blurb: Catching Adventures is a licensed and insured fishing guide service offering guided fishing adventures on lakes, North Shore rivers, and winter ice fishing in Northern Minnesota. They provide all fishing equipment so anglers only need to bring a smile and a lunch. Guests can catch a variety of fish including walleye, bluegill, northern pike, rainbow trout, salmon, and black crappie.
